svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.23 WOOD-FRAME CONSTRUCTION

g.text: ARTICLES 9.23.9.5. AND 9.23.9.6. READ TOGETHER, BY HEADER JOIST LENGTH
Header joist length around the floor opening
more than 800 mm, up to 1.2 m
more than 1.2 m, up to 2 m
more than 2 m, up to 3.2 m

svg.text: Trimmer joists around floor openings are
doubled when the length of the header joist
When the header joist exceeds 2 m (6′-6¾″) in
length, the size of the trimmer joists is
Drawn: trimmer joists in yellow. Headers follow Article 9.23.9.5. In C the doubled members only mark the trimmers, their size comes from calculations.
